I usually read a few Bible verses and go through a short devotional every morning before starting my day, and a lot of my decisions end up going back to what Scripture says. Do you think leaning on one book that much changes how someone deals with situations it does not really cover?

Leaning heavily on the Bible for guidance can provide comfort and wisdom, but it may also limit one's perspective and create uncertainty when faced with situations not directly addressed in the text. By integrating these strategies, one can make more informed and confident decisions, even when the Bible does not directly address the situation.
